name: LocalOps Linux Command Knowledge Base
description: Safe, structured diagnostic capabilities for common Linux troubleshooting problems.

uptime.description: Display system uptime and load average
use_when: The user reports high system load
The agent needs to investigate current system load

free.description: Display RAM and swap memory usage
use_when: The user reports high memory usage
The agent needs to investigate RAM pressure
The agent needs to investigate swap usage

-h.description: Display memory sizes in human-readable units

use_when: The user reports low disk space
The user reports that storage is full
The agent needs to investigate filesystem capacity

-h.description: Display disk sizes in human-readable units

-i.description: List inode information instead of block usage

use_when: The user reports high CPU usage
The user reports high memory usage
The agent needs to identify resource-heavy processes

aux.description: Show processes from all users in a user-oriented format

use_when: The user wants to inspect files
The agent needs to inspect a directory
The agent needs to verify whether files exist

-h.description: Display file sizes in human-readable units

id.description: Show current user and group IDs

systemctl.description: List failed system services without changing them

journalctl.description: Show recent current-boot errors; logs may contain private information
use_when: system errors, service errors, application crashes

nmcli.description: Inspect NetworkManager device and active connection status

pactl.description: Inspect audio server and audio devices

timedatectl.description: Inspect time zone and clock synchronization
use_when: wrong system time or time zone

apt-get.description: Check package dependency consistency without installing packages

check.description: Check dependencies without installing or removing packages

apt.description: List upgradable packages without applying upgrades

flatpak.description: List installed Flatpak apps and runtimes

lspci.description: List PCI hardware when pciutils is installed

lsusb.description: List USB hardware when usbutils is installed

sensors.description: Inspect hardware temperature sensors, voltages, and fan speeds

acpi.description: Show battery, thermal, and AC adapter status

-V.description: Show all available ACPI device information

vmstat.description: Display virtual memory, swap activity, I/O, and CPU statistics

iostat.description: Display CPU and storage device I/O statistics

ss.description: Inspect network sockets, connections, and listening ports

-tuln.description: Display listening TCP and UDP sockets without name resolution

lscpu.description: Display CPU architecture, cores, sockets, frequency, and cache information

mpstat.description: Display per-processor and multi-CPU core utilization

lsmod.description: Show the status of modules in the Linux kernel

system_slow.description: Investigate a generally slow Linux system
